description: A powerful avatar of nature personified, Orochi began to spread its dark influence around the world, granting power to those it deemed worthy of its 'blessing'. But as some would belatedly realize, it was not a free ride to the top. Indeed, Orochi's might would end up consuming the unworthy even as it boosted their strength. Those that had outlived their usefulness were trampled underfoot by Orochi's servants without a sound. Soon, it would reenter the world as it possessed its chosen avatar, intent on wreaking havoc in the world. Only the scions of its ancient enemies could stop it, but it was looking like their defeat was at hand...
summon:
Listen carefully, pitiful children...
Annihilation is approaching.
fusion: Nothing is greater than I am!
evolution: Now, let us return to nothing!
